messages.subject: Letter of Claim - Maybrook Aggregates / HelmCrush HC-450
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Sirs,

We act for Maybrook Aggregates Limited. Please find attached our Letter of Claim under the Pre-Action Protocol for Construction and Engineering Disputes in respect of the HelmCrush HC-450 plant supplied under the agreement of 14 March 2025.

We invite your full written response within 28 days. A hard copy follows by post.

Kind regards,
Tom

Tom Gallagher | Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0500
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Letter of Claim - Maybrook Aggregates / HelmCrush HC-450
messages.plaintextBody:
Mr Gallagher,

Received. We dispute this entirely. The HC-450 is a sound machine - the failures were caused by your client feeding it oversized rock and ignoring the alarms. We've passed this to our solicitors, Pemberton Rowe, who will respond.

T. Helmsworth
Helmsworth Plant Hire Ltd
